_comment: Known, pre-existing regression issues accepted for now. Owner decision 2026-10-08, verbatim: 'change the gate - so that there are no NEW failures'. dmt_regression_run.py classifies every failure (kind FAIL) and review item (kind REVIEW) as KNOWN (listed here) or NEW. Entries match on kind + category + object/sub/key only (key = row display key with the run prefix stripped), never on volatile text. Any NEW failure or NEW review item blocks the ATP gate; a sub-object that regressed against the baseline run is always NEW even if listed. When the harness prints 'KNOWN item cleared', delete that entry. FAIL categories: QUEUE_FAILED, QUEUE_STUCK (object); EXPECTED_OUTCOME, GOOD_ROWS_FAILED, BAD_ROWS_LOADED, EMPTY_ERROR_TEXT (sub); NON_TERMINAL_ROW (sub + optional key). REVIEW categories: ZERO_RECORDS (object), REST_VERIFY (object + sub). There are no known FAIL items today.
